description.zh: 配置集ID，多个英文逗号隔开。必填
description.en: The IDs of the configuration sets. Separate multiple IDs with commas. This parameter is required.

description.zh: 强制删除发信地址关联
description.en: Specifies whether to force delete the associations with sender addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm config-set-delete --ids xxx --is-force true --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm ConfigSetDelete --region cn-hangzhou --IsForce true --Ids xxx
